items.title: James Hunter interviewed by Monk Rowe, Boston, Massachusetts, July 25, 2018
items.q: I remember reading about Clyde McPhatter and deciding, just on the description, that he was my favorite singer.

ctx.x: Were you a guy, when you were young went to the record stores.

Yeah. Browsed through for pretty obscure stuff and that. I remember reading about Clyde McPhatter and deciding, just on the description, that he was my favorite singer. I’d never heard him. But the way this bloke described his voice I thought I’ve got to hear this. And this is about 1980s. You couldn’t find it. They weren’t re-issuing that sort of stuff. And so I went in this little record shop in Southend-on-Sea on my lunch break, because that was Southend-on-Sea in Essex was within our jurisdiction as a signal…
You know the thing you mentioned, liner notes, were great back then.
